summary: CEIR-12a sec-36 the resource dialect: resource declaration, views/ranges/subresources over the 3c resource types, and import/export of externals. Resource-ness rides the TYPE (the CEIR-3c Buffer/Image/View/ResourceTable/ExternalResource/Tensor kinds) -- NOT a new trait (kKnownTraitsMask is pinned) -- and cross-op typing is enforced by the module-walk verifier Context::find_resource_misuse (the find_token_misuse house pattern). Lifetime classes + memory-domain intent + residency hints LANDED in CEIR-12b as declaration-site attrs: resource.declare carries lifetime/history_length/memory_domain/residency (CLOSED vocabularies, enforced) + streaming_priority/budget_class/size_class (OPEN tags, 12c/12d consume; size_class is the sec-78 alias slot bucket added CEIR-12c), resource.export carries direction (closed, enforced) -- all validated by the SEPARATE module walk Context::find_resource_intent_misuse (12a's find_resource_misuse stays the TYPE contract). CEIR-12c ADDS the alias/lifetime ANALYSIS (Context::compute_block_lifetimes + resources_interfere/resources_may_alias) over these attrs + the 4d effects; CEIR-12d ADDS the memory PLANNER (Context::plan_block_memory -> the inspectable MemoryPlan: greedy interval-coloring within a (size_class, kind) bucket, the §78 PlanProfile, per-assignment SlotReason for §162 explainability; ADR-0124). The finer sec-25 machinery (sparse pages, virtual textures, budget classes, prefetch, feedback-driven residency) is the CEIR-12d planner's, named-forward. alias/lifetime ANALYSIS (which consumes the alias_group attr + the export effect) is CEIR-12c; the memory planner is CEIR-12d. Reference/interpreter semantics are a NAMED-FORWARD: an uninstalled resource op is a typed NoSemantics (the async precedent), landing when the resource runtime + provider binding land (13+ / sec-150). Provider handle binding for import/export is a sec-150 provider seam, named-forward to CEIR-13+.

ops.name: declare
ops.summary: Declare a graph-owned resource of a 3c resource type (the planner owns its memory).
ops.docs: The graph-owned resource definition site. Result type is a CEIR-3c resource kind. Pure (a value constructor -- no memory effect; reads/writes ride the ops that USE the resource). CEIR-12b attaches the planning-intent attrs HERE: lifetime (sec-20) + history_length (the history<T> ring depth) + memory_domain (sec-24 INTENT) + residency (sec-25 hint) are CLOSED vocabularies enforced by find_resource_intent_misuse; streaming_priority + budget_class + size_class (CEIR-12c sec-78, the alias slot bucket) are OPEN tags (12c/12d consume). ⛔ these are declare-ONLY -- the planner plans declare's resources, NEVER import's, so a planning-intent attr on an import is IntentAttrOnImport (nonsense-by-construction, the view-of-view legal-by-accident shape).

results.name: resource
results.doc: the declared resource value; type = a 3c resource kind (buffer/image/tensor/...)

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: an optional debug/identity name (attr-only this slice -- NOT a SymbolTable entry; cross-module resolution is CEIR-13+)

attributes.name: alias_group
attributes.doc: an optional alias-group tag; doc-only this slice -- CEIR-12c's alias/lifetime analysis CONSUMES it (given a syntactic home now so 12c mints no vocabulary mid-analysis)

attributes.name: lifetime
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b sec-20 the LIFETIME class: transient | persistent | history (absent = unspecified, the planner's default). A CLOSED vocabulary -- find_resource_intent_misuse enforces it. history<T> binds HERE: a persistent ring whose depth is history_length.

attributes.name: history_length
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b sec-20 the history RING depth in frames (>=1; absent under lifetime=history means 1 -- the TAA prev-frame case). ONLY valid with lifetime=history: find_resource_intent_misuse rejects it elsewhere (HistoryLengthWithoutHistory) and rejects <1 or a non-int (HistoryLengthInvalid).

attributes.name: memory_domain
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b sec-24 the memory-domain INTENT: host | pinned_host | device_local | host_visible_device | unified | upload | readback | sparse | external | peer_visible | distributed (absent = unspecified). A CLOSED vocabulary, enforced. sec-24's transient/persistent entries ride the `lifetime` axis (orthogonal), NOT here. INTENT only -- providers lower to Vulkan memory types / D3D heap flags (NEVER exposed as source semantics).

attributes.name: residency
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b sec-25 the residency HINT: resident | streamable | evictable (absent = unspecified). A CLOSED vocabulary, enforced. The finer sec-25 machinery (sparse pages, virtual textures, budget classes, prefetch, feedback-driven residency) is the 12d planner's -- named-forward.

attributes.name: streaming_priority
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b sec-25 an OPEN streaming-priority hint (alias_group-style: UNCHECKED by the walk -- open values; the 12d planner consumes it).

attributes.name: budget_class
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b sec-25 an OPEN budget-class tag (alias_group-style: UNCHECKED by the walk -- open symbol; the 12d planner consumes it).

attributes.name: size_class
attributes.doc: CEIR-12c sec-78 the memory SIZE-CLASS bucket (an opaque planner bucket id; absent = unspecified/0). OPEN value (UNCHECKED by the walk); the 12c alias/lifetime analysis reads it -- two transients may share a slot ONLY within the same (size_class, TypeKind) bucket (the frame graph's slot-SIZE scar, IR edition). ⛔ still declare-ONLY planning intent: on a resource.import it is IntentAttrOnImport.

ops.name: export
ops.summary: Publish a resource externally (a boundary; conservative MemoryReadWrite so the hazard walk orders it).
ops.docs: The external-publish boundary. A conservative MemoryReadWrite on operand 0 (writes before export must complete; external code may mutate) -- ordering-relevant for the CEIR-12c hazard walk. CEIR-12b adds the optional `direction` attr {read|readwrite} as an ADVISORY narrowing (the effect record itself stays conservative-both). find_resource_misuse enforces operand(0) is resource-kinded; find_resource_intent_misuse enforces the direction vocabulary.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.doc: CEIR-12b the publish DIRECTION intent: read | readwrite (absent = unspecified). A CLOSED vocabulary, enforced by find_resource_intent_misuse. ADVISORY: the EFFECT record stays a conservative MemoryReadWrite (TOML-static, always ordering-relevant); this attr only NARROWS what the CEIR-12c hazard walk MAY assume (a read-only publish need not order against upstream reads).

ops.name: import
ops.summary: Import an externally-owned resource (provider-bound handle); the planner never plans its memory.
ops.docs: The externally-owned resource entry point. Distinct OP from declare (graph-owned vs externally-owned -- the planner plans declare's resources, NEVER import's). Pure at the IR layer; provider handle binding is a named-forward (sec-150 / CEIR-13+).

results.name: resource
results.doc: the imported resource value; type = a 3c resource kind (external_resource, or a typed externally-bound buffer/image)

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: an optional external identity name (attr-only; the provider resolves the real handle -- sec-150, CEIR-13+)

ops.name: view
ops.summary: A view/range/subresource over a resource; result = a View type carrying the range mask (offsets/sizes are runtime operands).
ops.docs: The unified view/range/subresource op. The mask is in the result View type; offsets/sizes are runtime operands (ascending ViewRange bit order). Pure. find_resource_misuse enforces: operand(0) resource-kinded; result.underlying == operand(0) type; mask valid for the underlying (view_combination_valid); num_operands == 1 + 2*popcount(mask).

operands.name: ranges
operands.doc: offset/size PAIRS per masked ViewRange dim, ASCENDING bit order (byte<element<mip<layer<aspect); count = 2*popcount(mask)

results.name: view
results.doc: the view value; type = ctx.type_view(underlying = operand(0)'s type, mask)
